data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 opened 2016 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 13.54m. During 2016 the Syndicate recorded a gross over-provision (release) on prior years of GBP 2.694m (a c.19.9% release of opening reserves) shown in the technical provisions as an 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses'. Management notes only modest catastrophe activity in the year (Alberta wildfires and Hurricane Matthew) and assesses broader legal/discount rate changes (Ogden) as not material; no quantified per-line-of-business reserve movements are disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses (2,694) - (2,694)
Whilst there was a modest increase in catastrophe losses in the year with the Alberta wildfires and Hurricane Matthew the impact on the Syndicate was modest.

On 27 February 2017 the Lord Chancellor announced a change to the discount rate in relation to compensation claims as a result of personal injury from +2.5% to -0.75%. The impact to the Syndicate has been assessed as not material.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement derived from the technical provisions reconciliation row 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' (gross). No per-line split of prior year movement available. Named catastrophe events are mentioned but not quantified for Syndicate 6104. Gross premium mix is a single 'Reinsurance' line as the statutory segmental analysis shows the syndicate writes only reinsurance.
